title: ixeris riparia
intro: Ixeris riparia, commonly known as Crepis riparia, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb native to East Asia, traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ixeris riparia include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
